# Measurement G3 tables (generated by analyze_g3.py)

## Stage decomposition (clock build, u4m, full collection, k=1000, 25 calibration queries x 5 rounds)

Range blocks (all of them; work spread over the GPU):

| paper category | our stages | mean per range block µs | share of range-block time | slowest range block µs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| allocation/zeroing | lookup_and_zero, word_table_prefix | 1.3 | 3.4% | 4.2 |
| traversal | decode_add | 10.2 | 26.2% | 70.2 |
| local top-k | radix_select_gather, bitonic_sort, candidate_write, threadfence, done_ticket | 27.4 | 70.3% | 28.6 |

Merge (top-k, last block only, once per query): merge stages 193.6 µs (count/scan 19.6, compaction 110.7, radix select 40.2; scatter 23.1); merge tail 161.8 µs = 19.3% of the kernel span.

Wall clock (globaltimer, median over queries): kernel span 839.7 µs = range phase 677.9 µs (all range blocks, in waves) + merge tail 161.8 µs. SM clock 2.50 GHz in the clock build; stage times exclude barrier waits (9.6% of warp time).

## Nsight Compute (u4m, full collection, k=1000, 25 launches; base clocks, caches flushed)

| counter | mean per launch | min - max |
|---|---|---|
| DRAM bytes read | 61.3 MB | 37.1 - 113.8 MB |
| DRAM bytes written | 3.72 MB | 1.57 - 6.64 MB |
| DRAM throughput, % of peak | 12.0% | 8.1 - 15.1% |
| achieved occupancy | 49.0% | 48.3 - 49.2% |
| L2 hit rate | 58.2% | 53.0 - 61.8% |
| kernel duration (ncu) | 1.089 ms | 0.826 - 1.650 ms |

Achieved DRAM bandwidth (read + write) / duration: 59 GB/s (RTX 4070 peak 504 GB/s).
